notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental: Total Governmental Funds column of p5-6; beginning -377,503 is the restated beginning fund balance (deficit) after the -127,853 reclassification printed on p6 (as printed -249,650 before); ending -584,925 = net cash (total assets 675,269 less deficit pooled cash 1,260,194). Receipts 'Taxes' 442,438 split into property tax 320,618 (General taxes, p9) and sales tax 121,820 (p9, p15); they add to the line. Debt/loan principal and interest payments printed under Other financing sources (uses) (p6) are recorded as governmental debt service disbursements with outside_printed_total (printed Total expenditures 1,406,963 kept). Transfers in/out equal 375,675 each; governmental statement transfers include transfers to/from enterprise funds none printed (proprietary statement p8 shows none). Business-type: p8 proprietary statement total column; receipts = operating revenue + interest income; disbursements include operating expenditures (incl. capital outlay 48,029) plus nonoperating debt principal and interest; beginning/ending are net position (equals cash for this modified cash basis), measure set to cash. Balance sheet is government-wide Total column (p1); the only liability is deficit pooled cash; no total liabilities printed (computed). Detail: per-fund budget-and-actual schedules p10-20 and nonmajor combining p21; the All Funds budgetary statement (p9) is a summary of the same funds and was not itemized to avoid double counting. Lines with blank actual (Ambulance receipt 49,241 budget, Legal and professional, Bond proceeds budget, Donations budget, Professional fees budget, misc budget lines, cemetery transfers budget) were skipped. Debt Service Fund schedule shows bond retirement/interest as disbursements while the fund statement (p6) shows them as other financing uses; recorded as printed on each. Read pages 1-21 of 21 Balance sheet (user 2026-10-27): governmental lines from the governmental funds statement of assets, liabilities and fund balances (p4), Total Governmental Funds column.
